narrative.overview:
Coolify reads as PaceUI's take on shadcn's neutral system: a quiet grey canvas holding one rounded page panel, and inside it white (or near-black) cards with a 1px border and a soft shadow. From `lg` the shell is inset: the sidebar, brand and status bar sit directly on the canvas, and the top bar's working half plus the page form a single 14px-cornered panel beside them. Everything a user acts on lives in a card with a header row; nothing is boxed twice.

Colour is restrained. Keys are ink, not blue: the primary is near-black on light and near-white on dark. Blue belongs to charts, links and command lines in the log; green, amber and red report state and nothing else. Motion is short and springy: cards rise in on arrival, keys and rows press in, grid cards lift on hover, chart bars grow from the axis. All of it stops under reduced motion. Dark mode is Deep Ocean: navy-indigo surfaces with no neutral greys, electric cyan keys, links and chart, and a soft cyan and indigo glow on the page panel.
keyCharacteristics: Inset shell: sidebar on the canvas, the page in one rounded panel with an 8px gutter.
Every section is a 14px card with a 1px border, a soft shadow and a header row; inner boxes lose their frames.
Ink primary key; outline secondary keys; blue only for charts, links and log commands.
DM Sans for the interface, JetBrains Mono for logs, times, SHAs, versions, counts and key caps.
Spring motion (rise, press, lift, grow) with reduced-motion handling.

rules.name: The Ink Key Rule
rules.body: The filled key is ink, never blue. Blue is for data and links; a blue button is off-system.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only to report live state (lamps, badges, rail and feed dots, meters, deltas, log lines, the failed chart series). They never fill a control or mark a category.

rules.name: The Machine-Text Rule
rules.body: Anything a machine wrote (log lines, SHAs, UUIDs, times in the feed, versions, counts, key caps) is JetBrains Mono. Labels and prose never are.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Titles, group names and badges are sentence case with no tracking; uppercase labels are off-system.

rules.name: The One Panel Rule
rules.body: From `lg` the page is a single rounded panel on the canvas; chrome (sidebar, brand, status bar) never sits inside it and cards never sit outside it.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth is a border plus a soft shadow, never a hard offset or a glow. Only grid cards lift on hover (2px up, overlay shadow); everything else stays put.

dos: Do put new tokens and component rules in `pace.css` under `html:root` / `html.dark` / `html:not(#icto-ui)`; answer upstream layered `!important` only inside `@layer utilities`.
Do make every new section a card: 14px, 1px border, card shadow, 52px header row with a 15px 600 title.
Do keep the filled key ink; outline keys for everything else.
Do use the chart blues for data series and keep green, amber and red for state.
Do use JetBrains Mono for logs, SHAs, UUIDs, times, versions, counts and key caps, with tabular numerals.
Do give new entrances the spring and the rise, and cover every animation with the reduced-motion rule.
donts: Don't fill a button blue or with a state colour.
Don't put a box inside a box; inner groups become seam-divided rows.
Don't use hard offset shadows, glows or blur; depth is border plus soft shadow.
Don't set labels in uppercase with tracking; titles and group names are sentence case.
Don't place chrome inside the page panel or cards outside it from `lg`.
Don't bring back brand purple; the logo stays greyscale.
